In this regard, the Authority is of the view that deployment of multi-base stations is done to meet capacity requirements and overlaps of cell coverage areas are defined for smooth handover for continuity of the services without any breaks or call drops. As such overlapping of cells is not a substitute for cell outages and consequent load takeover.
